# `tfctl profile profiles rename`

The `tfctl profile profiles rename` command renames an existing profile.

## Usage

```shell-session
$ tfctl profile profiles rename NAME --new_name=NEW_NAME [options]
```

## Description

The `tfctl profile profiles rename` command renames an existing profile. All configuration and settings are preserved; only the profile name changes.

## Arguments

- `NAME`: (Required) The current name of the profile to rename.

## Available options

The `tfctl profile profiles rename` command supports the following options.

| Option | Description | Default | Required |
|--------|-------------|---------|----------|
| `--new_name=NAME` | Specifies the new name of the profile. Cannot already exist and must follow the [Profile naming rules](/terraform/tfctl-cli/reference/cli/profile/profiles/create#profile-naming-rules). | None | Yes |

### Global flags

Refer to [Global flags reference](/terraform/tfctl-cli/reference/cli#global-flags) for information about flags you can use with all commands.

## Examples

The following examples demonstrate how to rename an existing profile.

### Rename a profile

The following example renames a profile. Replace `<OLD_NAME>` and `<NEW_NAME>` with the old and new names of the profile.

```shell-session
$ tfctl profile profiles rename <OLD_NAME> --new_name=<NEW_NAME>
```
